start.name: El-Tina area / Sinai-side gas-grid trunk origin near El-Qantara Sharq, opposite Port Said (UNCONFIRMED as this specific line's start -- see notes)
start.coord_basis: Rough proxy only: OSM node 'محطة التينة' (El-Tina railway Station), on the Ismailia road, tagged as Port Said Governorate (not the Sinai/east bank). This is the nearest independently-geocodable place bearing the name 'El-Tina' -- but the EIA source that actually establishes 'El-Tina East' as a Sinai-side gas-trunk origin (for the separate Abr Sinai/El-Tina East-El-Arish pipeline, 111 km) gives no coordinate, only that it sits in the 'El-Tina plain', south of El-Qantara Sharq town (30.8636N 32.3252E) on the Sinai/east-canal-bank side. This node may therefore be the wrong bank entirely.

end.name: Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station (Suez thermal power station complex near the Ahmed Hamdi Tunnel crossing)
end.coord_basis: OSM landuse=industrial polygon explicitly named 'محطة كهرباء عيون موسى البخارية' / name:en 'Oyoun Mousa Power Station' (way id 210209240) -- a direct, named-facility match, not a settlement proxy.

prior_passes.notes: END is solid: an OSM industrial-landuse polygon carries the exact bilingual name match (Arabic 'محطة كهرباء عيون موسى البخارية', name:en 'Oyoun Mousa Power Station'), independently corroborated as a real gas-fired plant in Suez by power-technology.com and PGESCo's own project page (both fetched but gave only city-level location text, not coordinates -- so not cited as route_refs, only as background corroboration of the plant's existence and fuel type). Also corroborated: an OSM-mapped checkpoint 'كمين عيون موسى' (Ayoun Moussa checkpoint) sits 8 km further south on the Sharm El-Sheikh road at 29.8604N/32.6597E, confirming 'Ayoun Moussa' as a real, geographically consistent place-name cluster (not a typo), matching the ~29.87N/32.65E area given in the task brief. START could not be defensibly pinned: EGAS-2018 PDF (the sheet's own cited source) does not contain this pipeline as a named row (grep across the full pdftotext output for 'Ayoun/Moussa/Mousa' returns nothing -- the report's grid-pipeline tables only cover pipelines completed/under construction in FY2017/2018, and this line is evidently older). The EIB 1998 press release confirms the general feed concept (Mediterranean offshore gas via parallel west-bank/Sinai-bank pipelines to Ayoun Moussa) but is for a 275 km project, likely not a 1:1 match to this 145 km/24in line. Recommend leaving RouteAccuracy at 'no route' or, at most, marking only the END point at moderate accuracy pending a named Sinai-side origin.  abarrelfull was not consulted (banned).
